name: JellySubSync
description: Shift subtitles earlier or later from the TV remote (JellyXR TV app).
overview: Pause twice quickly in Jellyfin on Android TV and the JellyXR TV app shows a subtitle sync box. JellySubSync writes a shifted copy of the subtitle track (the original stays untouched), remembers the offset per item, and the app restarts playback on the synced track.
changelog: 1.0.0.0: First release. Shifts text subtitles (SRT, ASS/SSA, WebVTT, and embedded text tracks) for the JellyXR TV app sync box (app 1.2.0 or newer).
